bounds: three Spindles, 20 s per scenario, seeds 1 and 2
command: cargo build --release --locked --workspace --bins --examples && for s in clean server-kill node-kill outage; do for seed in 1 2; do python3 -B tools/qualification/delivery_faults.py --scenario $s --seed $seed --seconds 20 --keep || exit 1; TLA_JAR="$PWD/target/tools/tla2tools.jar" python3 -B formal/delivery/trace_check.py target/alpha-delivery-$s-$seed/transcript.jsonl || exit 1; rm -rf target/alpha-delivery-$s-$seed; done; done && ! python3 -B tools/qualification/delivery_faults.py --scenario clean --seed 3 --seconds 8 --mutate drop-recovered
scope: Real server and Spindle processes under SIGKILL and outage, graded by the delivery oracle, and each transcript validated by TLC against the DeliveryOwnership model; plus the drop-recovered negative control
trust: written by cargo xtask checks; unsigned; proves structure, not execution
unchecked_behavior: Physical power loss; more than three Spindles; latency.
